name: Electricity Act, 2003
change: Introduced deregulation in electricity generation, allowed private sector participation, and created regulatory commissions for tariff and distribution oversight.
impact: Improved competition and efficiency in the power sector, but issues like DISCOM losses and power theft still persist.

name: National Electricity Policy, 2005
change: Outlined long-term strategies for power generation, transmission, and distribution with focus on universal electricity access.
impact: Guided expansion of power infrastructure and rural electrification, though supply reliability remains uneven.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana, 2005
change: Focused on providing electricity connections to rural households and infrastructure in villages.
impact: Significantly increased rural electrification, though quality and continuity of supply remain concerns.

name: National Solar Mission, 2010
change: Promoted large-scale solar power generation through subsidies, solar parks, and capacity targets.
impact: Triggered rapid growth in solar energy capacity and reduced dependence on fossil fuels. Solar capacity has increased massively over the last decade. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: Ujwal DISCOM Assurance Yojana (UDAY), 2015
change: A financial restructuring scheme aimed at improving the health of power distribution companies by reducing debt and improving efficiency.
impact: Helped reduce financial stress of DISCOMs initially, but long-term sustainability challenges remain.

name: Saubhagya Scheme, 2017
change: Provided last-mile electricity connections to all households, especially in rural and remote areas.
impact: Achieved near-universal household electrification, improving quality of life and economic opportunities.

name: National Wind Energy Mission, 2014
change: Focused on expanding wind power capacity through incentives, policy support, and infrastructure development.
impact: Increased renewable energy share and supported clean energy transition, though intermittency remains a challenge.

name: Hydro Power Development Policy, 2008
change: Encouraged development of hydroelectric projects through financial incentives and regulatory support.
impact: Supports renewable energy generation and grid stability but raises environmental and displacement concerns.

name: National Bio-Energy Mission, 2018
change: Promotes use of biomass, biogas, and waste-to-energy technologies for power generation and fuel production.
impact: Reduces waste and supports clean energy production, though scalability remains a challenge. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

name: Green Hydrogen Mission, 2023
change: Promotes production and use of green hydrogen as a clean fuel alternative for industries and transport.
impact: Supports long-term decarbonization and energy independence, but requires high investment and technological advancement. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
